note: Rename order: plugin options saved in the settings file under the plugin's name before the rename (pluginConfigs keys starting with the old name and @) are not read; /status prints one warning line per such key with its option count and the key to move them to in /config (the key this plugin reads now, else <name>@…). Read-only: the settings file is unchanged; no option value is printed; a key that only starts with the old name's letters, another plugin's key and an empty option set print nothing
